name: JellyXR
description: X-Ray style cast cards on pause (Android TV friendly).
overview: Scans videos once with on-server face recognition to learn which cast members appear when. Pause on Android TV and JellyXR sends text cards with the actors on screen (this scene) or the whole episode cast.
changelog: 1.5.0.0: X-Ray markers. Movies and episodes with X-Ray data get an "X-Ray" tag and join an "X-Ray" collection, so the Android TV app (which can't show plugin UI) shows which items have X-Ray: Collections -> X-Ray, or filter by tag. Optional: also add "X-Ray" as a genre so it shows on the TV movie page. New scheduled task "Mark items with X-Ray data" (daily 05:00). Settings: Mark items, Also add as genre, Marker name.
